description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_GetConfigVariable, which provides a method to retrieve configuration variables within the Smarty template engine. It is part of the internal plugins, specifically a method class used to implement getConfigVariable functionality.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_GetConfigVariable
classes.description: Provides a method to retrieve configuration variables from Smarty data objects.

methods.name: getConfigVariable
